question: Which action is incorrectly performed in exactly two videos?

observed_information.statement: A black chassis with wheels is held while an orange cabin part is reached for.
An orange cabin is attached to a vehicle while a white tank module is brought toward the rear section.
A person appears to attach or detach a cabin section on a vehicle body with wheels nearby.
A wheel is attached to the underside of a toy vehicle chassis with a screwdriver.
White plastic pieces identified as base and tank are held and compared after an orange cabin is placed down.
An orange cabin is attached to a chassis that already has a white tank mounted.
An orange cab is detached from a white tank chassis, with both components resting on the table.
An orange cab is attached to a white tank chassis, forming a complete truck assembly.

working_relations.statement: v1 and v3 both report an orange cabin or cab in relation to a white tank or chassis, but the sequence and correctness of tank-base-cabin connections are not settled.
v2 and v3 both show handling or transition of a cabin or cab section, but whether the action is attachment, detachment, or an incorrect operation is not visible.
All three videos report chassis or screwdriver work near wheels or underside, which is potentially relevant to base-chassis attachment but does not identify a base component.
The reports mention cabin, chassis, tank, and base pieces across videos, but no event explicitly identifies a roof component or roof-to-cabin attachment.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare whether any video shows a base component attached to a chassis and whether that attachment conflicts with the surrounding assembly sequence.
Compare whether the cabin or cab transitions are detachments of cabin and interior pieces rather than attachments or inspections.
Compare whether the white tank and base pieces are attached together or to the chassis in a way that conflicts with the assembly sequence.
Compare whether a distinct roof component is present and attached to a cabin in any video.
